title: What is a mental health and wellbeing practitioner? (MHWP)

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家完成他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode, we are introduced to the new kid on the block.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我们将介绍一位新成员。

sentences.en: We're looking at the role of mental health and well-being practitioner.
sentences.zh: 我们正在探讨心理健康与福祉从业者的角色。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 它是什么？

sentences.en: How can you train as it?
sentences.zh: 你如何接受相关培训？

sentences.en: What does it involve?
sentences.zh: 它涉及什么内容？

sentences.en: I'm joined by a brand new qualified mental health well-being practitioner called Harriet.
sentences.zh: 今天我邀请到了一位刚获得资格的心理健康与福祉从业者，她叫 Harriet。

sentences.en: Hope you will find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你会觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: It may just lead to your future career.
sentences.zh: 这可能会引领你未来的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Now, the route to becoming a qualified psychologist, whichever you prefer, may well involve different jobs, different roles, different transitions.
sentences.zh: 成为一名合格心理学家的途径，无论你偏好哪种，都可能涉及不同的工作、不同的角色和不同的过渡阶段。

sentences.en: Or, of course, we may choose to stop at any of the stages before and without progressing to qualified psychologist status.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们也可能选择在之前的任何阶段停下来，而不去追求合格心理学家的身份。

sentences.en: Today's guest contacted me to ask if I'd heard of this brand new kid on the block, which is called Mental Health and Well-Being Practitioner.
sentences.zh: 今天的嘉宾联系我，问我是否听说过这个新角色，叫做“心理健康与福祉从业者”。

sentences.en: I hadn't, but I was very interested to learn more.
sentences.zh: 我没听说过，但我非常有兴趣了解更多。

sentences.en: So, I've invited her on and we're going to learn together.
sentences.zh: 所以我邀请了她，我们将一起学习。

sentences.en: So, I hope you find this so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你会觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 期待在节目后段与你再见。

sentences.en: Hi, just want to welcome along Harriet Barnes to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎 Harriet Barnes 来到播客。

sentences.en: Hi, Harriet.
sentences.zh: 你好，Harriet。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for reaching out to me to help us learn more about the new role, but also the role that you are doing, which is the Mental Health and Well-Being Practitioner.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你主动联系我，帮助我们了解这个新角色，以及你目前正在从事的心理健康与福祉从业者的工作。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的邀请。

sentences.en: That's all right.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: I love being able to help illuminate new career options.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢帮助大家发掘新的职业选择。

sentences.en: So, this sounds like a really viable job and potentially career for somebody that's done a psychology degree.
sentences.zh: 所以，这听起来对于拥有心理学学位的人来说，是一份非常可行且有潜力的职业。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You don't, in the entry requirements when I applied for the role, there wasn't even a requirement for it to be a psychology degree necessarily.
sentences.zh: 其实在我申请这个职位时，入职要求里甚至不一定要求有心理学学位。

sentences.en: So, one element of the role is that it's encouraging people into a psychological profession or having the ability to provide psychologically informed interventions.
sentences.zh: 该角色的一个要素是鼓励人们进入心理学专业，或者具备提供心理学知情干预的能力。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: that's quite important to acknowledge that they're informed from lots of different backgrounds because they're quite keen to understandably sort of diversify the number and type of people offering psychology.
sentences.zh: 认识到这些干预措施来自不同的背景非常重要，因为他们非常希望能够使提供心理学服务的人员数量和类型多样化。

sentences.en: So, a lot of people in the role that I'm aware of do have a psychology degree, but not everybody, and it's certainly not a requirement when I applied, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这个岗位上的很多人确实有心理学学位，但并非所有人都有，而且至少在我申请时，这绝对不是硬性要求。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thanks for clarifying that.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的澄清。

sentences.en: Did you do a psychology degree?
sentences.zh: 你有心理学学位吗？

sentences.en: I did, yes.
sentences.zh: 有的，我有。

sentences.en: So, if you want to know just a tiny bit about my background, because everybody's backgrounds are so varied, it's not an example of a perfect, what you would need,
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解一点我的背景，因为每个人的背景都非常多样化，这并不是一个完美的范例，说明你需要什么，

sentences.en: but just so you can have an understanding.
sentences.zh: 只是为了让你有个了解。

sentences.en: So, I did my psychology degree and then I went to work in education.
sentences.zh: 我获得了心理学学位，然后去教育领域工作了。

sentences.en: So, I'd worked as an A-level psychology teacher and a few other roles around that for 15 years.
sentences.zh: 我曾担任 A-level 心理学教师，并从事过其他相关工作，长达 15 年。

sentences.en: And alongside that, I did my teaching master's and also a master's in psychological research.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我还获得了教学硕士学位以及心理学研究硕士学位。

sentences.en: And then took a few other roles just for a year or two because I wanted to kind of have an experience outside of education, working with asylum seekers, working at a university.
sentences.zh: 后来我换了几份工作，每份只做了一两年，因为我想在教育之外获得一些经验，比如与寻求庇护者合作，或者在大学工作。

sentences.en: So, not really out of education, but a different type of education, and then applied for this role, which has training attached to it as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然不算完全脱离教育，但属于不同类型的教育，之后我申请了这个职位，它还附带培训。

sentences.en: So, since I applied, I've completed my mental health and well-being practitioner training.
sentences.zh: 自申请以来，我已经完成了心理健康与福祉从业者的培训。

sentences.en: Gosh, amazing.
sentences.zh: 天哪，太棒了。

sentences.en: So, you're a fully qualified teacher with years and years of experience.
sentences.zh: 所以你是一位拥有多年经验的合格教师。

sentences.en: That must, you know, I think what I really like about psychology careers or about careers generally is that if you kind of have different careers, like a series of them,
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢心理学职业或一般职业的一点是，如果你经历过不同的职业，就像一系列职业一样，

sentences.en: you don't just stop bringing the stuff from your previous career, you know.
sentences.zh: 你不会停止运用之前职业中积累的东西，你知道的。

sentences.en: You're able to almost integrate and formulate whatever you're doing with the people you're working with the knowledge you bring forward.
sentences.zh: 你能够将你带来的知识与你正在做的事情以及你所接触的人进行整合和构思。

sentences.en: You don't stop being an A-level teacher, do you?
sentences.zh: 你不会停止做 A-level 老师，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, you bring that with you and that enhances your role.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你会带着那些经验，这会提升你的角色表现。

sentences.en: And I think it's clear that you're not doing A-level teaching, but all the skills, all of the kind of engagement, the brilliant way you'll have engaged your pupils over the years,
sentences.zh: 虽然很明显你现在不再教 A-level 了，但所有的技能，那种参与感，以及你多年来吸引学生的那种出色方式，

sentences.en: you know, and how to stop them being rowdy, I'm sure is useful.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还有如何让他们不再吵闹，我相信这都很有用。

sentences.en: You bring that with you.
sentences.zh: 你把这些都带过来了。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: I didn't expect, and it sort of seems silly now looking back, but at the time I sort of thought this is,
sentences.zh: 我没想到，现在回想起来似乎有点傻，但当时我确实觉得，

sentences.en: I almost felt like I was going into something completely brand new in the same way as I was when I first went into teaching.
sentences.zh: 我几乎感觉自己像刚开始教书时一样，进入了一个全新的领域。

sentences.en: So, you know, first started my career, I thought, gosh, I'm really starting right from the beginning again.
sentences.zh: 所以，刚开始职业生涯时，我想，天哪，我真的又从头开始了。

sentences.en: And in some ways I was, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，我确实是。

sentences.en: It's a new environment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个新的环境。

sentences.en: It's getting used to working in the, you know, within different systems within the NHS, just like you would in any, you know, changing any kind of organisation.
sentences.zh: 就像在任何组织中一样，需要习惯在 NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系）的不同系统内工作。

sentences.en: And sort of more of a focus on risk because of the client group that the MHWP role works with.
sentences.zh: 而且由于 MHWP 角色所服务的客户群体，对风险的关注度更高。

sentences.en: But actually, unexpectedly, a lot of the skills, because as much as I've taught in groups,
sentences.zh: 但出乎意料的是，很多技能是通用的，因为尽管我曾在小组中教学，

sentences.en: all my interventions are one-to-one and I have actually done one-to-one teaching as well in A-levels.
sentences.zh: 但我所有的干预都是一对一的，而且我在 A-level 教学中也确实做过一对一辅导。

sentences.en: And you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: I kind of, I have to be very mindful because I don't, to be fully a teacher wouldn't be appropriate in a psychological intervention.
sentences.zh: 我必须非常谨慎，因为在心理干预中，完全表现得像个老师是不合适的。

sentences.en: But a lot of the skills, like being able to pick up if somebody's saying they've got an example, but maybe they haven't, or if they're,
sentences.zh: 但很多技能，比如能够察觉某人是否在举例但可能并不属实，或者如果他们，

sentences.en: if they're drifting off and losing engagement, how to bring them back.
sentences.zh: 如果他们走神了，失去了参与感，该如何把他们拉回来。

sentences.en: And sort of just knowing how to communicate sort of psychological concepts to somebody in an accessible way.
sentences.zh: 还有就是知道如何以易于理解的方式向某人传达心理学概念。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely a lot more of the skills than I realised were transferable.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实比我意识到的有更多的可迁移技能。

sentences.en: And I think that was the case for a lot of people on my course with their different backgrounds, whatever they were,
sentences.zh: 我认为我课程中的很多人也是如此，无论他们有什么样的背景，

sentences.en: that they found a lot of the skills they developed just through life and through having any kind of career was really valuable.
sentences.zh: 他们都发现自己在生活中以及在任何职业中培养的许多技能都非常有价值。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And of course, it's making me think about the transactional analysis of how we kind of interact with each other.
sentences.zh: 当然，这让我想到了我们如何相互作用的交互分析。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that's anything you're familiar with, but there's three circles sort of stacked one on top of the other.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否熟悉这个，但有三个圆圈一个叠在一个上面。

sentences.en: And I think it's parent, teacher, child, and it's making sure that we know at any one time which role we're in.
sentences.zh: 我想是父母、成人、儿童，关键是要确保我们在任何时候都知道自己处于哪个角色。

sentences.en: So at the moment, I'm, if this is something you're not familiar with or our audience is not familiar with, you know, I'm doing the teaching.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，如果这是你不熟悉或我们的听众不熟悉的内容，你知道，我正在进行教学。

sentences.en: But it's useful in arguments when we realise sometimes me and my 10 year old are both stuck in child.
sentences.zh: 但在争论中，当我们意识到有时我和我 10 岁的孩子都陷入了“儿童”状态时，这很有用。

sentences.en: And that doesn't help an argument to kind of come to a nice, amicable end.
sentences.zh: 而这对于让争论以友好、圆满的方式结束并没有帮助。

sentences.en: So just being able to sometimes in the moment be able to just observe where we're at.
sentences.zh: 所以，有时能在当下观察到我们处于什么状态是很有帮助的。

sentences.en: And I'm not a transactional analysis expert there.
sentences.zh: 我不是交互分析专家。

sentences.en: So if anyone's like, look, that's entirely wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人说，看，那完全错了。

sentences.en: What I know I am right about is there's three circles and we need to look at where we're at.
sentences.zh: 我确定的是有三个圆圈，我们需要看看我们处于什么位置。

sentences.en: So if anyone wants to come on and discuss that because I've got it all horrendously wrong, please do feel free.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人想来讨论这个问题，因为我可能完全弄错了，请随时提出。

sentences.en: So what happened then?
sentences.zh: 那么后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Did you, were you already working in a role and then you heard about the MHWP or you saw it advertised?
sentences.zh: 你是已经在某个岗位工作，然后听说了 MHWP，还是看到了招聘广告？

sentences.en: How did that unfold for you?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么接触到这个职位的？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I was working in a role in teaching and also working for a charity as well, part time.
sentences.zh: 是的，当时我在做教学工作，同时也兼职为一家慈善机构工作。

sentences.en: And about a year after I'd finished my full time teaching, A-level psychology teaching role.
sentences.zh: 那是在我结束全职 A-level 心理学教学工作大约一年后。

sentences.en: And it was always something I'd wanted to do, but decided now was the right time.
sentences.zh: 这一直是我一直想做的事情，但我决定现在是合适的时机。

sentences.en: So just started to look for job adverts.
sentences.zh: 所以就开始寻找招聘广告。

sentences.en: So not too many tips in terms of finding them, but they're definitely out there just on the NHS.
sentences.zh: 在寻找方面没有太多技巧，但它们确实在 NHS 的网站上。

sentences.en: It was the NHS jobs track website.
sentences.zh: 那是 NHS 的招聘网站。

sentences.en: I came across, I'm trying to think what search terms I use, because at the time I didn't actually know the role existed.
sentences.zh: 我偶然发现了它，我在想我用了什么搜索词，因为当时我根本不知道这个角色存在。

sentences.en: It's a very new role.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常新的角色。

sentences.en: The first, I was in the second cohort, the first cohort of people recruited across the country.
sentences.zh: 我是第二批学员，是全国范围内招募的第一批人。

sentences.en: I haven't even been qualified a year yet.
sentences.zh: 我获得资格甚至还不到一年。

sentences.en: So it was very new when I was looking at it in the summer of 2022.
sentences.zh: 所以我在 2022 年夏天寻找时，它非常新。

sentences.en: So I just use lots of different search terMs.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是用了许多不同的搜索词。

sentences.en: And I think, I guess for me, it was just being open-minded.
sentences.zh: 我想，对我来说，就是保持开放的心态。

sentences.en: So it could have perhaps been an assistant psychology role I was looking at or a psychological well-being practitioner role.
sentences.zh: 所以它可能是我正在寻找的心理学助理角色，或者是心理健康从业者角色。

sentences.en: And then when I saw this one, I was just open-minded to this one, possibly being one that I'd be interested in as well.
sentences.zh: 然后当我看到这个时，我只是对这个角色保持开放态度，这可能是我也会感兴趣的一个。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I know when I was looking for roles, I used to just literally sometimes search through all of the band four and five jobs within 30 miles of my house,
sentences.zh: 我知道当我寻找职位时，我过去常常会逐字逐句地搜索我家 30 英里内所有的 4 级和 5 级工作，

sentences.en: just to see if there was anything that would use my skills that I could apply for.
sentences.zh: 只是为了看看是否有任何工作能用到我的技能，我可以申请。

sentences.en: So I think, yeah, just getting a bit crafty with your search terms is a really good idea.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，是的，在搜索词上花点心思是个好主意。

sentences.en: Is it a funded role to train?
sentences.zh: 这是一个带薪培训的职位吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it's when I applied for it, it was called a trainee mental health and well-being practitioner role.
sentences.zh: 我申请时，它被称为心理健康与福祉从业者实习生职位。

sentences.en: So it came with a year of training that was funded by the by the service.
sentences.zh: 所以它附带了一年的培训，由服务部门资助。

sentences.en: And then once you were in service, you remain with it.
sentences.zh: 一旦你进入服务部门，你就会留在那里。

sentences.en: So you train the service that you train in the team that I trained in.
sentences.zh: 所以你在你接受培训的团队中进行培训。

sentences.en: And once I then had qualified, I moved from a band four to a band five and remained within that team as a permanent member of the team.
sentences.zh: 一旦我获得了资格，我就从 4 级转到了 5 级，并作为团队的正式成员留在了那个团队中。

sentences.en: So that's quite nice.
sentences.zh: 这很不错。

sentences.en: I think that's quite different.
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常不同。

sentences.en: Speaking to the nurses in the community mental health team, once they qualify, they have to like lots of roles.
sentences.zh: 与社区心理健康团队的护士交谈时，他们一旦获得资格，就像许多角色一样，

sentences.en: They have then have to look for a job.
sentences.zh: 他们必须寻找工作。

sentences.en: So there's the stress of qualifying, doing all the hard work.
sentences.zh: 所以有获得资格的压力，做了所有的艰苦工作。

sentences.en: And then there's the on top of that, not necessarily knowing straight away where you'll work.
sentences.zh: 然后除此之外，还不一定能马上知道你在哪里工作。

sentences.en: So that's a really nice thing about this role.
sentences.zh: 所以这是这个角色非常好的地方。

sentences.en: You do a year of funded training and working in the service at the same time.
sentences.zh: 你进行一年的带薪培训，同时在服务部门工作。

sentences.en: So you're building the relationship, starting to cement where the role fits within the team.
sentences.zh: 所以你正在建立关系，开始巩固该角色在团队中的位置。

sentences.en: And then once you're qualified, if anything, whilst it's new, because then you're qualified and your responsibilities change slightly,
sentences.zh: 一旦你获得了资格，如果有什么变化的话，因为那时你已经合格了，你的职责会略有改变，

sentences.en: it's the relief of just working in service and not having to do any of the training, which is quite nice.
sentences.zh: 在服务部门工作而无需进行任何培训是一种解脱，这很不错。

sentences.en: Yeah, ideal.
sentences.zh: 是的，理想。

sentences.en: So it's the service that I've identified.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我确定的服务部门。

sentences.en: There's a gap in the market for this role.
sentences.zh: 这个角色在市场上存在空白。

sentences.en: So we will train the person, get to know them, and then almost like a preceptorship, like then you graduate and you become your band five qualified MHWP.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将培训这个人，了解他们，然后就像实习一样，毕业后你就会成为 5 级的合格 MHWP。

sentences.en: Are there assignments and things to do along the way as well, Harriet?
sentences.zh: Harriet，过程中还有作业和要做的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I started the training in November 2022.
sentences.zh: 是的，我于 2022 年 11 月开始培训。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: And there are three modules in it.
sentences.zh: 里面有三个模块。

sentences.en: So it varies, but generally it's about two or three days out of your role is on training.
sentences.zh: 所以情况各不相同，但通常你大约有两到三天的时间脱离岗位进行培训。

sentences.en: And my training was online.
sentences.zh: 我的培训是在线的。

sentences.en: And I would assume that most with a university and I'd assume that most post would be online because our university covered a huge area geographically.
sentences.zh: 我想大部分大学课程应该都是在线进行的，因为我们大学覆盖的地理区域非常广。

sentences.en: So I think realistically, that's what most universities would also do.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为现实来看，大多数大学也都会这么做。

sentences.en: And there were three modules.
sentences.zh: 课程分为三个模块。

sentences.en: The first module had an assignment and something called an OSCE attached to it and focused on assessing people with.
sentences.zh: 第一个模块包含一项作业和一项名为OSCE的考核，重点是评估那些患有……的人。

sentences.en: And this is a phrase that's used in the course because it's connected to the role and why it exists for working with people with severe mental health needs compared to IAPT or perhaps as they're called now talking therapies,
sentences.zh: 这是课程中会用到的一个短语，因为它与该职位的性质有关，也解释了为什么在处理严重心理健康需求时需要这个职位，相比于IAPT（或者现在所谓的谈话疗法），

sentences.en: a mild to moderate mental health needs.
sentences.zh: 即轻度到中度的心理健康需求。

sentences.en: It's this role is aimed more at people with what they call severe mental health needs or complex mental health needs.
sentences.zh: 这个职位的目标群体更多是那些有所谓严重心理健康需求或复杂心理健康需求的人。

sentences.en: And so the first module is assessing.
sentences.zh: 所以第一个模块是关于评估的。

sentences.en: So coming in and we learn things like the five Ps formulation, how to how to build a relationship with someone, a rapport, how to assess risk, how to develop that formulation.
sentences.zh: 我们学习的内容包括“五P”构思法、如何与人建立关系、建立融洽感、如何评估风险以及如何制定构思方案。

sentences.en: The second module is around care planning, and that has an assignment and a reflective essay to it attached to it.
sentences.zh: 第二个模块是关于护理计划的，同样包含一项作业和一篇反思性文章。

sentences.en: And that's about how to, as the module suggests, how to plan somebody's care.
sentences.zh: 正如模块名称所示，这部分是关于如何为某人规划护理方案。

sentences.en: So how to kind of think about ensuring that all of the needs are met in the most appropriate way, enjoy the most, is looking at the interventions that we offer.
sentences.zh: 也就是如何思考确保以最合适的方式满足所有需求，并关注我们所提供的干预措施。

sentences.en: And that's the same thing.
sentences.zh: 情况也是一样的。

sentences.en: It's an assignment and then something called an OSCE.
sentences.zh: 也是一项作业，然后是所谓的OSCE考核。

sentences.en: And both of the assignments, both in module one and module three, are case studies.
sentences.zh: 模块一和模块三的作业都是案例研究。

sentences.en: So you work with a particular person and then anonymously write up a case study about how you either assess them if it's module one or how you provided a psychological intervention if it was module three.
sentences.zh: 你需要与特定的人合作，然后匿名写一份案例研究，记录你是如何评估他们的（如果是模块一），或者你是如何提供心理干预的（如果是模块三）。

sentences.en: And OSCE is essentially, and the way, role plays.
sentences.zh: OSCE本质上就是角色扮演。

sentences.en: So the way they did them is, I know they've changed, they're slightly different now.
sentences.zh: 他们当时的做法是这样的，我知道现在已经变了，稍微有些不同。

sentences.en: But the way that mine was done is they had, they hired people with lived experience of mental health needs to play the role of a service user or a patient.
sentences.zh: 但我当时经历的是，他们聘请了有心理健康需求亲身经历的人来扮演服务对象或患者的角色。

sentences.en: And then they watched us live and recorded us as we provided.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会现场观察并录下我们提供服务的过程。

sentences.en: In the first one, we provided an assessment session.
sentences.zh: 第一次考核中，我们进行了一次评估会谈。

sentences.en: And in the second OSCE, we provided a psychological intervention, which they chose for us, which was our confidence building one.
sentences.zh: 在第二次OSCE中，我们提供了一项心理干预，这是他们为我们选择的，也就是我们的自信心建立课程。

sentences.en: I think that's changed now.
sentences.zh: 我想现在已经改了。

sentences.en: I guess it all depends how you feel about OSCEs and how things work.
sentences.zh: 我想这完全取决于你对OSCE的看法以及具体的操作方式。

sentences.en: I think they've changed it to try and make it a little less stressful in that you can now record it with someone else, another member of staff in the team as the service user.
sentences.zh: 我想他们已经做出了调整，试图减轻压力，现在你可以和团队中的另一名员工一起录制，由对方扮演服务对象。

sentences.en: Or if you have a service user, you can ask them to do it.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你有现成的服务对象，也可以请他们来配合。

sentences.en: So you don't have the pressure of knowing there's a third person right there in the moment, live, listening to you and judging you.
sentences.zh: 这样你就不会有那种“现场有第三个人在看着你、评判你”的压力了。

sentences.en: Although that sounds really scary, I found actually that they were really supportive.
sentences.zh: 虽然听起来很吓人，但我发现他们其实非常支持我们。

sentences.en: They're really keen for you to achieve everything that you need to and understand everything you need to.
sentences.zh: 他们真心希望你能实现所有目标，并理解你需要掌握的一切。

sentences.en: But they are really keen to support you to pass.
sentences.zh: 他们真的很想支持你通过考核。

sentences.en: They want you to pass.
sentences.zh: 他们希望你通过。

sentences.en: They're not there to make your life difficult or sort of hide what the assessment criteria is.
sentences.zh: 他们不是为了让你难堪，也不是为了隐瞒评估标准。

sentences.en: They're as supportive as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们尽可能地给予支持。

sentences.en: So it wasn't as scary as it quite sounded.
sentences.zh: 所以它并没有听起来那么可怕。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That's so illuminating.
sentences.zh: 这太有启发性了。

sentences.en: And it's also made me reflect upon my first ever assignment as a trainee clinical psychologist, which was a role play.
sentences.zh: 这也让我回想起了我作为临床心理学实习生时的第一次作业，那也是一次角色扮演。

sentences.en: So we were divided into groups of three.
sentences.zh: 我们被分成了三人一组。

sentences.en: I think one of us was doing filming.
sentences.zh: 我想其中一个人负责拍摄。

sentences.en: One of us was doing the talking.
sentences.zh: 一个人负责交谈。

sentences.en: And then one of us was a patient.
sentences.zh: 另一个人扮演患者。

sentences.en: And then it was service users who rated what they thought about us.
sentences.zh: 然后由服务对象来评价我们的表现。

sentences.en: I think there was three service users rated each of our videos and it felt mortifying.
sentences.zh: 我想当时有三位服务对象评价了我们每个人的视频，感觉真是太尴尬了。

sentences.en: You know, I think anybody who's going to train the mental health role is going to need to be able to tolerate their distress at the idea that there will be role plays, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为任何想要从事心理健康工作的人，都需要能够忍受这种压力，因为会有角色扮演，

sentences.en: and that there may well be feedback on those role plays.
sentences.zh: 而且这些角色扮演很可能会收到反馈。

sentences.en: And we just need to kind of hold, notice that distress, but then being able to tune into the feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要保持并察觉这种不安，但同时也要能够专注于反馈本身。

sentences.en: And, you know, in my case, it was, it was good.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，就我而言，结果还不错。

sentences.en: You know, I remember one piece of feedback from a service user said, there's nothing I wouldn't talk to her about.
sentences.zh: 我记得一位服务对象给出的反馈说：“没有什么是我不能跟她说的。”

sentences.en: Like, she's really welcoming.
sentences.zh: 就像，她真的很热情。

sentences.en: She's really compassionate.
sentences.zh: 她真的很富有同情心。

sentences.en: Like, you know, I was like, oh, well, that's, that's all right.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，哦，那，那还不错。

sentences.en: That's a high compliment, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这可是很高的评价，不是吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: And then I think that gives you permission then to, to go on, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 我想这会给你继续下去的动力，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, actually, maybe I'm, maybe I'm not as bad as I thought I was.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其实，也许我并没有自己想的那么差。

sentences.en: Maybe this is all right.
sentences.zh: 也许这一切都还行。

sentences.en: So in the podcast, I think it's often quite helpful to think about jargon busting.
sentences.zh: 所以在播客中，我认为进行“术语拆解”通常很有帮助。

sentences.en: And often I use loads of jargon.
sentences.zh: 我经常使用大量的术语。

sentences.en: I know what things need.
sentences.zh: 我知道这些词的意思。

sentences.en: And it's like the jargon we use is common sense.
sentences.zh: 但我们使用的术语其实就是常识。

sentences.en: Always try to put it in brackets and in full so that people know what you mean.
sentences.zh: 我会尽量把缩写放在括号里并写出全称，这样人们就能明白你的意思。

sentences.en: What does OSCE stand for?
sentences.zh: OSCE代表什么？

sentences.en: Do you know, Harriet?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，哈丽特？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, it stands for an objective structured clinical examination.
sentences.zh: 是的，它代表“客观结构化临床考试”。

sentences.en: But you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 但你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: It was, I had to look it up and we didn't, we used it on the course without even questioning it really.
sentences.zh: 我当时还得去查一下，我们在课程中一直用它，甚至都没质疑过它。

sentences.en: And then as I sort of thought it stood for and I thought, oh, I don't, I don't actually know.
sentences.zh: 后来我思考它代表什么时，我心想，哦，我其实根本不知道。

sentences.en: So you are right.
sentences.zh: 所以你是对的。

sentences.en: It's very easy to fall into that trap of using jargon and, and not realizing definitely.
sentences.zh: 很容易陷入使用术语却不自知的陷阱，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think as well with you, with you mentioning about feedback, that was a skill that I discovered
sentences.zh: 另外，提到反馈，我发现那是我通过教学培养出来的一项技能，

sentences.en: that I'd, something I developed through my teaching that then was, that I then was able to apply and something that I, you know, again, sort of, gosh, didn't expect that that would
sentences.zh: 后来我能够将其应用到工作中，这又是我……天哪，我没想到这会是

sentences.en: be something I would, I'd need to do.
sentences.zh: 我需要做的事情。

sentences.en: I found, because I found feedback really valuable, but it was very tempting to be quite self-critical
sentences.zh: 我发现反馈非常有价值，但人们很容易变得自我批评，

sentences.en: and focus on the negatives and beat yourself up about the things that you, that you couldn't change.
sentences.zh: 专注于负面因素，并为那些你无法改变的事情而自责。

sentences.en: And in teach, for anyone who doesn't know, in teaching, there's a lot of observation that goes on.
sentences.zh: 在教学中，对于不知道的人来说，会有很多观察环节。

sentences.en: We're observed regularly in the classroom by management, by peers, and very occasionally by, if we're really unlucky, by Ofsted.
sentences.zh: 我们经常在课堂上被管理层、同事观察，如果运气不好，偶尔还会被英国教育标准局（Ofsted）观察。

sentences.en: And so I found that something really difficult that I needed to develop, and I found something
sentences.zh: 所以我发现这是一件我需要克服的难事，而且我发现一个非常有用的方法是，

sentences.en: that I found really useful was I would print off my, or get in front of me my feedback and have it broken down at each point that was made.
sentences.zh: 我会把反馈打印出来，或者放在面前，把每一条建议都拆解开来。

sentences.en: And I found it, I skipped straight to the stuff that was about areas for development.
sentences.zh: 我发现我总是直接跳到关于“发展领域”的内容。

sentences.en: So I found that I had to, I really made a point of focusing on the strengths, exactly like you said, to really remind myself of those.
sentences.zh: 所以我强迫自己一定要专注于优点，就像你说的，时刻提醒自己那些长处。

sentences.en: But then with the areas for development, I found myself going quite circularly around a point maybe that either I didn't agree with, or I thought, well, that was just unfortunate
sentences.zh: 但对于发展领域，我发现自己会陷入死循环，纠结于那些我不同意的点，或者觉得那是当天运气不好，

sentences.en: on the day, or I can't change that.
sentences.zh: 或者是我无法改变的事情。

sentences.en: So what I found really helpful was I'd have a, I'd keep a clean copy, but I'd also have a
sentences.zh: 所以我发现非常有用的做法是，我保留一份干净的副本，但同时也会有一份副本，

sentences.en: copy where I would cross out any of those that I didn't, I couldn't do anything about, because
sentences.zh: 我会划掉那些我无能为力的点，因为这真的很有帮助，让我不再纠结于“哦，我对此无能为力，真倒霉”。

sentences.en: that really helped me then, instead of focusing on, oh, I can't do anything about that, that was my, that was, how unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，那些负面情绪实际上就消失了。

sentences.en: It then actually, they disappeared.
sentences.zh: 然后我不得不承认，好吧，确实，那是一个有效的建议。

sentences.en: And then I had to admit, well, actually, yeah, that is a valid point.
sentences.zh: 但与其想“我为什么让那种事发生？”，

sentences.en: But then instead of just thinking, oh, why did I let that happen?
sentences.zh: 我会想：现在，我能做些什么来改变它？

sentences.en: I'd think right now, what can I do to change that?
sentences.zh: 然后我会把它写在旁边，比如，有什么是我可以推进的？

sentences.en: And I'd write that next to it, like, what is something I can move forward?
sentences.zh: 然后我承诺将其付诸实践。

sentences.en: And then I committed to putting that into place.
sentences.zh: 所以我发现这是一种管理反馈的非常有效的方法。

sentences.en: So I found that a really useful way of, of managing feedback.
sentences.zh: 哦，非常感谢你与我们分享这些。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you so much for sharing that with us.
sentences.zh: 这太重要了。

sentences.en: That's so important.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为在这些心理健康职业中，这不仅是为了你个人的发展，也是为了客户的安全。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think in, in these mental health careers, it's, it's for your own development, but it's also for client safety.
sentences.zh: 重要的是我们接受过观察，人们有机会体验与我们共处一室的感觉，无论是虚拟的还是现实中的房间。

sentences.en: It's important that, that we have been observed, that people have had a chance to experience what it's like to be in a room with us, either virtually or actually in a room.
sentences.zh: 我们需要塑造自己，我们需要成长。

sentences.en: And we need to shape, we need to grow.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真心关心如何减轻我所服务客户的痛苦。

sentences.en: You know, I genuinely care about easing the distress of the clients I work with.
sentences.zh: 如果有什么我能做的能让这种情况更有可能发生，我想知道。

sentences.en: And if there's something I can do that would make that more likely to happen, I want to know it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，有时候这确实非常困难。

sentences.en: But, you know, you absolutely sometimes, it's really difficult.
sentences.zh: 有时候，我认为我们应该看看“同情心聚焦疗法”。

sentences.en: And sometimes, you know, I think we look at compassion focused therapy.
sentences.zh: 有时候，我们内心愤怒的那一部分会占据主导。

sentences.en: We, sometimes the angry part of ourselves will be in charge.
sentences.zh: 那就是把一切都搞砸的那部分。

sentences.en: And that's the part that scribbles it all out.
sentences.zh: 有时候悲伤或焦虑的那部分可能会控制局面。

sentences.en: Sometimes the sad part or the anxious part might be in control.
sentences.zh: 那又是另一种说法了。

sentences.en: And that's what something different to say.
sentences.zh: 希望随着时间的推移，结合了同情心的自我能够走上舞台，

sentences.en: Hopefully over time, the, the combined compassionate self will be able to step into the floor and
sentences.zh: 变得更加客观，并作为一名成长中的临床医生，对自己更加支持。

sentences.en: be a little bit more objective and, you know, supportive to yourself as a growing clinician.
sentences.zh: 但同时，我认为我们作为合格的临床医生也应该接受观察。

sentences.en: But also, you know, I think we should be observed as, as qualified clinicians as well.
sentences.zh: 所以活到老学到老，我认为我们总能进步，但有时候，你知道，

sentences.en: So every day is a school day and I think we can always improve, but sometimes, you know,
sentences.zh: 我也曾遇到过投诉我的客户。

sentences.en: I've worked with clients who've complained about me as well.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们就是无法适合所有人，因为我们不可能做到。

sentences.en: Sometimes we're just not a good fit for everybody because we can't be.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们知道自己与某人建立了非常好的临床融洽关系。

sentences.en: And sometimes we know that we've got a really, really good clinical rapport with somebody.
sentences.zh: 而有时候我们知道关系有点僵，你知道，这要么是因为我们之间有些东西合不来，就是行不通。

sentences.en: And sometimes we know it's just a little bit sticky, you know, and that's either, it's just something about some of us that we get together and it just doesn't, just doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 这不合适。

sentences.en: It's not a fit.
sentences.zh: 有时候你只需要想，好吧，也许分配给另一位临床医生会更好，你知道，有一个新的开始。

sentences.en: And sometimes you just need to think, well, actually, maybe this is best being assigned to a different clinician, you know, have a fresh start.
sentences.zh: 找一个能，我不知道，能与这位客户建立更自然融洽关系的人。

sentences.en: Someone that, that can kind of just, I don't know, have a more natural rapport with this client.
sentences.zh: 我们都是不同的，不是吗？

sentences.en: We're all different, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我认为当他们招聘心理健康岗位人员时，这是一个非常大的重点，这也是为什么他们非常渴望多样性的原因。

sentences.en: And I think that's a really big focus when they look to recruit people into the mental health role and also why they're really keen for a wide variety.
sentences.zh: 所以当然有心理健康背景的人，但并不是岗位上的每个人都如此。

sentences.en: So absolutely there are people with a psychological mental health background, but not everybody in the role.

sentences.en: Like, that's getting me a bit teary, I won't lie.
